nodes.label: DM Sans Typography System
nodes.rationale: DM Sans chosen for dual fluency scaling from 80px hero displays with -2px letter-spacing down to 12px micro labels; single typeface strategy with weight-based emphasis instead of italics.

nodes.label: Product Color Encoding
nodes.rationale: Each model line gets a distinct vibrant brand color reserved only for product-identity moments — coral M2.7, magenta Music 2.6, blue Hailuo, purple Speech 2.8 — never for general buttons or body text.

nodes.label: SSO Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Nuxt 3 fullstack with Tailwind+DaisyUI v4, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, oidc-provider, Pino logging, and Argon2 hashing for an internal office OIDC IdP.

nodes.label: Access Check Priority Chain
nodes.rationale: Access is additive: requireAccessGrant gate, then direct user_app_access, then group membership; groups cascade-delete mappings and coexist with direct grants.

nodes.label: oidc_kv Persistence Adapter
nodes.rationale: Generic key-value Postgres store for oidc-provider artifacts (sessions, tokens, auth codes, grants) chosen over per-artifact tables for MVP simplicity.

nodes.label: SSO Security Model
nodes.rationale: Three auth layers (end-user, admin role check, client secret); PKCE required; Argon2id hashing; rate limits; opaque access tokens resolved via userinfo/introspection.

nodes.label: Opaque Access Tokens
nodes.rationale: Access tokens are opaque references; clients must use /userinfo or token introspection to obtain claims rather than decoding JWTs.

nodes.label: openid-client Library
nodes.rationale: Recommended generic OIDC client for Node; alternatives include passport-openidconnect, @auth0/nextjs-auth0, and nuxt-auth-utils depending on framework.

nodes.label: JWT Signing Key Rotation
nodes.rationale: Rotate JWKS every 90 days by adding a new kid, keeping prior key until old tokens expire, then removing the old key.

nodes.label: Audit Log Retention Policy
nodes.rationale: Recommended retention: audit logs 2 years for compliance, application logs 30 days, debug logs 7 days.

nodes.label: Single Issuer Multi-Site Strategy
nodes.rationale: Prefer one issuer reachable by all three sites via VPN/internal DNS; multi-issuer only if domains cannot share access; MVP focuses on single issuer with Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite cookies.

nodes.label: oidc_kv MVP Adapter Choice
nodes.rationale: MVP selects generic oidc_kv adapter over per-artifact tables to reduce schema complexity while persisting oidc-provider state in Postgres.

nodes.label: OIDC vs SAML Protocol Choice
nodes.rationale: Agent must compare OIDC vs SAML 2.0 and recommend the best fit for Nuxt plus modern internal web apps before implementation.

nodes.label: Existing App SSO Integration Strategies
nodes.rationale: Four options: full migration, federation/account linking, auth gateway, and discouraged password sync — with identity mapping and provisioning considerations.

nodes.label: VS Code Copilot SSO MVP Prompt
nodes.norm_label: vs code copilot sso mvp prompt

nodes.label: No Password Sync Constraint
nodes.rationale: Explicit MVP constraint: do not sync passwords with HRIS; HRIS is source of truth for users via stub sync only; MFA deferred to design hooks.

nodes.label: Client-side SSO session revoke check mechanism
nodes.rationale: Package stores the SSO account id (userInfo.sub) in its own cookie, separate from the host app's session, and periodically checks the issuer for revocation. Design intent stated in README: 'Tidak perlu menyimpan token apa pun di sisi host — paket menanganinya sendiri' (the host app never needs to store any token; the package handles session/token management itself, reducing host-side security surface).
